heading.title: Of the Duties of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: Wages for certain services to be next paid, and then other debts.
article.content:
322Wages for certain services to be next paid, and then other debts.

Section 322  ·  Part IX · Chapter VII  ·  page 85 of the Act
Wages due for services rendered to the deceased within three months next preceding his death by any labourer, artizan or domestic servant shall next be paid, and then the other debts of the deceased according to their respective priorities (if any).
